+# dir differently from the harbor-miles branch this glue was written for:
+# symlinks that resolve outside the task dir are rejected as inputs, and a
+# ``trajectory.json`` beside the instruction is seeded into the agent as
+# prior ATIF context (failing the trial when the agent cannot load it). The
+# old stack followed symlinks and ignored that file. The task pool relies
+# on both (shared ``solution/`` symlinks; SFT seed files named
+# ``trajectory.json``), so such a task is handed to Harbor as a dereferenced
+# copy with the seed file(s) dropped. Tasks without either feature pass

+        if any((Path(root) / name).is_symlink() for name in dirs + files):
